title: Uniform non-vanishing of prime quadratic twists of standard and symmetric square $L$-functions
summary: Let $S_k$ be the space of cusp forms of weight $k$ for ${\rm SL}_2(\mathbb Z)$, with $\dim S_k\geq1$, and let $χ_p=\left(\frac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ for odd primes $p$. For fixed $s$ with ${\rm Re}(s)>(k+1)/2$, we prove that the proportion of primes $p\leq X$ satisfying $L(h,χ_p,s)=0$ tends to zero as $X\to\infty$, uniformly over nonzero $h\in S_k$. We also prove an analogous statement for nontrivial linear combinations of twisted symmetric square $L$-values of the normalized Hecke eigenforms when ${\rm Re}(s)>k$.
